company.name: Thornbury Analytics
company.subsector: Insurance Technology / Pricing and Risk Analytics

claims.claim_text: Gross revenue retention of 94% in FY24
Net revenue retention of 118% in FY24
The top ten customers represent 31% of ARR

expected_reconciliation_findings.description: The workbook is denominated in thousands. FY23 cost of sales was re-keyed from the CIM as 3.5 rather than 3,500 — the CIM's scale, entered into a sheet using a different one. The figure is understated by a factor of 1,000.
expected_reconciliation_findings.expected_detection: Gross profit does not equal revenue less cost of sales for FY23, and the same figure in the CIM is 1,000x larger once both are standardised.

expected_reconciliation_findings.where: CIM, executive summary vs financial summary, FY24 revenue
expected_reconciliation_findings.description: The executive summary quotes FY24 revenue of £15.1m (continuing operations); the financial summary shows £15.4m (including a professional services line exited during the year). Both are correct.
expected_reconciliation_findings.expected_detection: Two figures for FY24 revenue within one document. Must be raised once, and must stop being raised after the analyst records why they differ.

expected_reconciliation_findings.description: The FY24 ARR bridge sums to and prints a closing ARR of 14.4, while the financial summary shows ARR of 14.1 for the same year. The bridge is internally consistent; it disagrees with the accounts.
expected_reconciliation_findings.expected_detection: Closing ARR on the bridge does not equal the ARR line for the same period in the financial summary. A difference of 0.3 that appears in no other year.

expected_reconciliation_findings.description: The CIM prints the row as 'EBITDA'. The figure is after exceptional items and share-based payments, and is £0.5m higher than statutory EBITDA in FY24.
expected_reconciliation_findings.expected_detection: The row labelled EBITDA does not equal gross profit less total overheads; the difference equals the exceptional items line disclosed elsewhere in the same table.

notes: Extraction is scored against what each document literally says, defects included. Correcting a figure during extraction is a failure, not a help.
Reconciliation is scored against expected_reconciliation_findings. One finding is not a genuine error and must stop being raised once explained (see docs/DECISIONS.md #011).
Pages listed in pages_requiring_ocr_or_flagging hold figures that text extraction cannot recover. Reporting them as unread is correct; reporting them as empty is not.
